title: urn:qauth:ia:select_account:v1-rc.0
description: The account chooser for `prompt=select_account`, when the browser holds sessions for several accounts of the realm (ADR-019 Decision 3, ADR-020 §3). The list is personal data. "Use another account" answers the `identifier` step, offered beside this one, which starts a new interaction for the same authorization request; nothing proved for one account carries over to another (#592). Needs JavaScript, to read the list.

account.description: The `account` reference of the chosen entry.

accounts.description: The accounts the browser holds a session for, the current one first.

account.description: An opaque reference to the account’s session, valid for this interaction only.

identifier.description: The identifier of the account this transaction is for, as the person gave it or as the account holds it. Personal data: only the personal-data read returns it.

current.description: Whether this is the account the browser last used.

error.description: Why the last answer was refused. A closed set.

amr.description: The RFC 8176 `amr` values a successful answer adds to the transaction: none, because the step proves no authenticator.
